findings.description:
Reentrancy in OrderManager.withdrawAssets(IERC20,address,uint256) (contracts/v1/vault/OrderManager.sol#180-235):
	External calls:
	- totalRedeem = _redeemFromMarket(order,orderInfo) (contracts/v1/vault/OrderManager.sol#196)
		- ITermMaxOrder(order).withdrawAssets(orderInfo.ft,address(this),ftReserve) (contracts/v1/vault/OrderManager.sol#283)
		- (totalRedeem,None) = orderInfo.market.redeem(ftReserve,address(this)) (contracts/v1/vault/OrderManager.sol#285)
	- _burnFromOrder(ITermMaxOrder(order),orderInfo,maxWithdraw) (contracts/v1/vault/OrderManager.sol#213)
		- order.withdrawAssets(orderInfo.ft,address(this),amount) (contracts/v1/vault/OrderManager.sol#272)
		- order.withdrawAssets(orderInfo.xt,address(this),amount) (contracts/v1/vault/OrderManager.sol#273)
		- orderInfo.market.burn(address(this),amount) (contracts/v1/vault/OrderManager.sol#277)
	- _burnFromOrder(ITermMaxOrder(order),orderInfo,amountLeft) (contracts/v1/vault/OrderManager.sol#216)
		- order.withdrawAssets(orderInfo.ft,address(this),amount) (contracts/v1/vault/OrderManager.sol#272)
		- order.withdrawAssets(orderInfo.xt,address(this),amount) (contracts/v1/vault/OrderManager.sol#273)
		- orderInfo.market.burn(address(this),amount) (contracts/v1/vault/OrderManager.sol#277)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- _accretingPrincipal -= amplifiedAmt (contracts/v1/vault/OrderManager.sol#234)
	VaultStorage._accretingPrincipal (contracts/v1/vault/VaultStorage.sol#35) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- OrderManager._accruedPeriodInterest(uint256,uint256) (contracts/v1/vault/OrderManager.sol#300-306)
	- OrderManager._checkLockedFt() (contracts/v1/vault/OrderManager.sol#344-346)
	- OrderManager.dealBadDebt(address,address,uint256) (contracts/v1/vault/OrderManager.sol#252-269)
	- OrderManager.withdrawAssets(IERC20,address,uint256) (contracts/v1/vault/OrderManager.sol#180-235)

		- ITermMaxOrder(order).withdrawAssets(orderInfo.ft,address(this),ftReserve) (contracts/v1/vault/OrderManager.sol#283)
		- (totalRedeem,None) = orderInfo.market.redeem(ftReserve,address(this)) (contracts/v1/vault/OrderManager.sol#285)
	- _burnFromOrder(ITermMaxOrder(order),orderInfo,maxWithdraw) (contracts/v1/vault/OrderManager.sol#213)
		- order.withdrawAssets(orderInfo.ft,address(this),amount) (contracts/v1/vault/OrderManager.sol#272)
		- order.withdrawAssets(orderInfo.xt,address(this),amount) (contracts/v1/vault/OrderManager.sol#273)
		- orderInfo.market.burn(address(this),amount) (contracts/v1/vault/OrderManager.sol#277)
	- _burnFromOrder(ITermMaxOrder(order),orderInfo,amountLeft) (contracts/v1/vault/OrderManager.sol#216)
		- order.withdrawAssets(orderInfo.ft,address(this),amount) (contracts/v1/vault/OrderManager.sol#272)
		- order.withdrawAssets(orderInfo.xt,address(this),amount) (contracts/v1/vault/OrderManager.sol#273)

	- OrderManager._accruedPeriodInterest(uint256,uint256) (contracts/v1/vault/OrderManager.sol#300-306)
	- OrderManager._checkLockedFt() (contracts/v1/vault/OrderManager.sol#344-346)

OrderManager.withdrawAssets(IERC20,address,uint256) (contracts/v1/vault/OrderManager.sol#180-235) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- block.timestamp >= orderInfo.maturity + Constants.LIQUIDATION_WINDOW (contracts/v1/vault/OrderManager.sol#194)
	- block.timestamp < orderInfo.maturity (contracts/v1/vault/OrderManager.sol#207)

OrderManager.withdrawAssets(IERC20,address,uint256) (contracts/v1/vault/OrderManager.sol#180-235) has external calls inside a loop: maxWithdraw = orderInfo.xt.balanceOf(order).min(orderInfo.ft.balanceOf(order)) (contracts/v1/vault/OrderManager.sol#209)
